test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is true about disposable income in relation to personal income?

options.text: Disposable income is equal to personal income.
Disposable income is always less than personal income.
Disposable income is always greater than personal income.
Disposable income can be greater or less than personal income, depending on taxes and deductions.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Disposable income is always less than personal income.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Disposable income is always less than personal income.**
 
• Disposable income is the amount of money that households have available for spending and saving after income taxes have been accounted for.
